g.text: An extra day bought: AI cuts cyclone forecast error by a day’s lead time
Solid/dashed: global TCs 2023–2025 (Nature/DeepMind Fig. 2, digitized). Open markers: Atlantic 2025 NHC (GDMI, HCCA). Track n mi from km (1 n mi = 1.852 km).
